$comment: Operations no tool may ever expose (D-9). The manifest test fails if it intersects this list, by operationId or by path. Covers: admin and platform surfaces, credentials, webhooks, and anything that charges balance, issues tax documents or moves money. writePathPrefixes deny every NON-GET operation under the prefix (withdrawals and domain registration move money); their reads stay allowed. Prospección (vertical-prospeccion D-24): el MCP lee objetivos, embudo y prospectos SIN datos de contacto y da de alta/importa prospectos; aprobar, enviar, marcar enviado, modo, traspaso, supresión, mensajes y cualquier lectura de contacto quedan fuera. Cupones (cupones-motor-core D-15): el MCP lista, consulta, exporta, crea y edita los cupones del espacio (incl. pausar/archivar por PATCH); el canje de saldo (/users/coupons), las rutas de máquina de tiendas (/integrations/coupons) y el protocolo de canje (/coupons/redemptions) quedan fuera. createCouponBatch exige Idempotency-Key y el MCP nunca envía esa cabecera; createMyStoreCoupon puede cobrar la tarifa de emisión de la tienda (saldo): ninguno de los dos se expone. Los cupones de una tienda propia se leen (listMyStoreCoupons, getMyStoreCoupon) pero no se modifican desde el MCP (updateMyStoreCoupon pausa, reanuda, archiva o edita un cupón vivo de la tienda: queda en el panel). Los adjuntos de los mensajes de Prospección (api#1390) siguen la regla de mensajes de D-24: fuera. VD-30: sendPaymentLinkAgain emails a customer and remains a human action in the dashboard; Data tools stay read-only; initializeDataDashboard is an explicit UI write, never a side effect of the MCP listing. Knowledge base (rag-en-agentes RAG-09): the MCP lists the sources, reads usage and the sync selection, and tries a search (searchKnowledge charges one knowledge search per call, US$0.02 today: it is a write that asks for confirmation, and its price is in the tool description). Out: createKnowledgeSource (multipart upload, while the MCP only sends JSON bodies; it also charges indexing from the balance before the document becomes searchable), reindexKnowledgeSource (charges indexing again), deleteKnowledgeSource (removes fragments and the stored file with no refund of paid indexing: irreversible) and updateKnowledgeSync (replaces which FAQs and sites feed the agents' answers, public ones included, and turning something off removes what it contributed at once): the four stay in the dashboard.

reviewedResponseKeys.$comment: Response keys that match the sensitive pattern and were reviewed as NOT secret. Anything else matching must be in the tool's redact[] (T-22).
reviewedResponseKeys.authorization_number: Número de autorización FEL de una factura certificada: identificador fiscal público, impreso en la propia factura.
reviewedResponseKeys.total_tokens: Cantidad de tokens de modelo que consumió una ejecución de agente: un contador de uso, no una credencial.
